description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `BaseOpenmrsService` that implements the `OpenmrsService` interface. It provides default (empty) implementations for lifecycle methods `onShutdown()` and `onStartup()`, serving as a base class for other service classes in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsService
classes.description: An abstract class providing default implementations for the OpenmrsService interface, intended as a base class for other service classes.

methods.name: onShutdown
methods.description: Default empty implementation of the onShutdown lifecycle method for services, called when the service shuts down.

methods.name: onStartup
methods.description: Default empty implementation of the onStartup lifecycle method for services, called when the service starts.
